chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Mutawakkil narrated to us; he said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'dawi narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd from Sulayman ibn Rashid from his father from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever recites the Quran is rich, and there is no poverty after it; and [he is] secure/wealthy except for what is in it [as a lack].'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of reciting the Quran according to Imam Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) declares that reciting the Quran grants a state of spiritual richness (ghina), effectively eliminating poverty, as the Quran itself is the ultimate source of sufficiency. The phrase 'al-amanah' (security/wealth) is interpreted here as the Quranic text, suggesting that true self-sufficiency is found within it, except for any specific deficiencies or needs one might still possess. This hadith underscores the Shia scholarly view that the Quran is not merely a book of law but a living source of divine wealth and contentment for the believer.
